questions.question: The shell is blocked by the host sandbox, so `od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6` can't run. How do you want to get the byte dump?

options.label: Open the sandbox.bash setting myself, then you run od
options.description: Setting sandbox.bash to off makes shell commands run unconfined (the container is then the only boundary). I'd re-run the od command once it's on.

options.label: Leave the sandbox alone — the verified file content is enough
options.description: You have the exact post-edit content above; run `od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6` yourself if you want the literal dump.
